messages:
jess-support: heads-up: multiple customers on SFO dedicated pools receiving eviction notifications + 429 / placement failures. acme-corp reported ~30% QPS drop. seeing 'placement failed: no capacity' in their logs. Anyone else? @leo-oncall @maria-sre

leo-oncall: saw alerts for sfo-pool GPU_alloc_free < 5%. Autoscaler fired scale-down earlier then failed to scale up due to placement errors. Looks like lower-priority tenants are getting evicted.

maria-sre: tracing shows allocator leak: a set of long-running allocations stuck in PENDING -> allocated but not released. Also seeing a noisy tenant id=tenant-882 causing >70% of KV cache occupancy on several nodes. Investigating.

dan-infra: starting cross-region fallback routing for affected customer groups to us-east1 now. Disabled autoscaler for sfo-pool to prevent further aggressive scale-down. Commands executed:
```
# disable autoscaler for sfo pool
retool infra pool update sfo-pool --autoscaler=off
# set fallback to us-east1 for priority customers
retool routing set-policy --pool sfo-pool --fallback us-east1 --priority-list acme-corp,midmarket-12
```

asha-engml: can we get a minimal repro? need a request_id + payload example from acme so we can run in our perf harness. If noisy tenant is spiking KV usage we should cap max_kvcache_per_tenant.

jess-support: acme sent sample request id: req_0a9c3f, snippet from their error stream:
```
2026-03-17T13:01:42Z ERROR placement failed: no capacity for model=gptx-large seq_len=2048 tenant=acme-corp req=req_0a9c3f
2026-03-17T13:01:43Z WARN eviction notice: tenant=acme-corp preempted_gpus=2
```

leo-oncall: temporarily migrated acme-corp Dedicated routing to us-east1 (manual warm-up + cache prefill). Latency returned to baseline on that tenant. Monitoring for 30m.

maria-sre: found runaway process on node sfo-GPU-17 holding allocations; killed process and freed 4 GPUs. Patching allocator to enforce a 5m allocation timeout and adding metrics for stuck_allocs.

dan-infra: note for customers with cross-region restrictions: CS has been notified and we sent opt-in form. Plan B is to spin emergency reserved capacity in SFO (manual fleet spin) — costly but faster for customers who cannot fail over.

jess-support: CS will offer acme credits + pre-warm in us-east. Collecting impacted customer list, sharing with infra.

deploy-bot: [deployment] hotfix allocator-timeout v1.2.5 promoted to sfo pool at 1923456890

maria-sre: hotfix applied, autoscaler re-enabled with safer min-size and more conservative cooldown. Also enforced per-tenant KV cache limit to 8GB and added eviction reason logging.

leo-oncall: monitoring shows GPU_free up to 18% and placement errors dropped to 0. Rolling for 1h stable window then will close.

jess-support: action items: 1) postmortem owner: @maria-sre 2) CS follow-ups & credits 3) decide on permanent routing fallback policy for SFO 4) update runbooks for eviction/placement events.

asha-engml: added acme's long-batched request (seq_len=2048 + heavy beam) to perf harness to validate we don't regress.

jess-support: thanks all — will update the escalation ticket and ping when we hit the 1h stable mark. :thumbsup:
